suggested_fix: Remove the local codex_available/cursor_available declarations or derive them directly from the four re-read probe keys; add happy-path tests where each external is available

what: Repo-unavailable and deferred paths can reach coder selection without plan artifacts
scenario_or_breakage: phase_plan_materialize skips on REPO_UNAVAILABLE, but the widened post-tracking guard can still populate coder; Step 2 then fails in run-step2-dispatch.sh because feature-description.txt or plan.txt is missing
suggested_fix: Add an explicit artifact/repo gate before phase_coder_select or route these paths to Step 18 before Step 2; add a repo-unavailable --up-to-phase coder/all test

what: Proposed _phase_coder_append_warning uses /dev/stdin against an API that requires a regular output file

suggested_fix: Write the warning to a mktemp file before calling append-tool-failure.sh, or use append-execution-issue.sh for synthetic warning text and test with the real helper behavior
